**Article Details for PMID: 35953131**

**Title:** Mendelian Randomization Study of PCSK9 and HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibition and Cognitive Function.

**Authors:** Daniel B Rosoff, Andrew S Bell, Jeesun Jung, Josephin Wagner, Lucas A Mavromatis, Falk W Lohoff

**Journal:** Journal of the American College of Cardiology
**Publication Date:** 2022-08-15
**DOI:** 10.1016/j.jacc.2022.05.041

**Abstract:**
Lipid-lowering therapy with statins and proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibition are effective strategies in reducing cardiovascular disease risk; however, concerns remain about potential long-term adverse neurocognitive effects.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
